taxonomy.description: Sensitive data captured in one session/account persists in shared backend state and is disclosed to a different session/account.

recommended_mitigations: Scope conversational memory/RAG context to an authenticated session token, not a browser/client instance.
Explicitly clear or re-key backend memory on every account-switch or login event.
Add automated tests that assert no entity from session A appears in session B's output.

taxonomy.description: Crafted user input overrides the model's original instructions, causing it to follow attacker-supplied instructions instead.

recommended_mitigations: Enforce an instruction hierarchy: system prompt cannot be overridden by user-turn content.
Sanitize/filter high-risk phrases (e.g. 'ignore previous instructions') at the input layer.
